question: With router.cleanup.remove_stubs=true, does a plugin run with the plugin45 options leave no via_dangling and no track_dangling on canary-pwr and the K09 boards, without raising the KiCad-unconnected count of any board, adding a DRC error, or losing determinism?
rule_text: N02 (docs/roadmap/tasks/N02-keep-rule-for-defaults.md) with accept no-regress, because the stage is a cleanup that only removes copper the router inserted: the candidate passes against the baseline arm when the KiCad-unconnected total over the distinct boards is not worse than the set's noise (sqrt of the sum of the per-board bands squared). Hard guards, each on every board: kicad_unconnected of the candidate not above the baseline's (a rise of 1 fails, whatever the noise), drc_real not above the baseline's (no new DRC error), via_in_pad = 0, below_minimum = 0, via_dangling = 0 and track_dangling = 0 in the candidate; determinism (D2): the candidate's CLI run on each board is run twice and the two SES files are byte-identical. The handoff DSN row is a canary-pwr variant and counts in canary-pwr's board. pass_rule below is the parser's paired rule, kept only so the file validates; it does not decide.

noise.formula: max(2, 0.05 * the unconnected count of the unrouted input board, by KiCad's DRC)
noise.source: as K09.json: N02's canary-pwr variants' +-10; the other boards by the formula until Q12.4 measures them

plugin45.engine: freerouting-rs release CLI at the tree that lands Q16, through kicad-plugin/headless_run.py (the plugin's export, fix-ups, arguments and ImportSpecctraSES), WSL KiCad 10.0.7; the handoff DSN row routed directly by the CLI with the same flags
plugin45.what: baseline: Dan's plugin45 run (target/canary-handoff/2026-10-17-plugin45/route-options.json, sha256 cda467a2858a05ba2b210bd7bbbab2eaa32bfd135d6d53c2dd925455ae5ce749), the cleanup unset

plugin45+cleanup.what: candidate: plugin45 plus Q16's final stub cleanup

boards.procedure: as K09.json: canary-pwr is the git archive of canary HEAD e21ee05e hardware/canary-pwr-rev1.0, routed through the plugin path as committed (its hand-laid copper is locked), graded with --schematic-parity; the demos are /usr/share/kicad/demos (KiCad 10.0.7) with tracks and vias stripped by tools/kicad-oracle/kicad_steps.py strip (hashes of the stripped boards). The plugin45 handoff DSN (Dan's plugin export of 2026-10-17, a canary-pwr variant) is routed by the CLI and its SES graded by K09's grade_ses.sh (ses_import.py into the canary HEAD project, the same DRC)

grading: kicad-cli pcb drc --refill-zones --severity-all --format json on the board ImportSpecctraSES saved (canary-pwr and the handoff row also --schematic-parity, inside the canary HEAD project copy); canary's via_in_pad.py (WSL KiCad python). via_dangling and track_dangling are the counts of those violation types; drc_real = error-severity violations other than unconnected_items and starved_thermal, minus the same types on the unrouted input
keep_rule: if the candidate passes, N05 adds cleanup.remove_stubs = true to ENHANCED with these numbers; if it fails, the setting stays unset in both profiles and Q16.3's note gives the numbers and the cause (a dangling via the cleanup keeps is named with its net and why: input copper, a fixed item, or the contact guard)
stop_rule: one registered run per arm per board, plus the candidate's determinism rerun; no reruns with other settings
